reframe: Upstream app features flow in automatically only if the fork stops diverging on that feature's file. Re-triage every app hard-conflict file into REVERT (drop non-essential divergence -> auto-inherit upstream), OVERLAY (relocate essential fork behavior to sources/fork/* + revert canonical file to near-upstream + thin seam), or ACCEPT (irreducibly convergent -> permanent manual-3-way).

keyFinding: The fork's identity threads through the MAJORITY of the 59 files via shared symbol names (storage state shape hasOlder/renderWindow, no-central-server socket/ops, codex/gemini tooling, DFS session tree, e-ink permission model). A file is a clean REVERT only if its divergence is BOTH cosmetic AND symbol-disjoint from the accepted core. Worked example: useDemoMessages.ts looks like throwaway demo content but carries the render-window pagination field rename -> NOT a revert. Verify per-file, not by category.
newLever_overlay_list: Catalogue/list files (model catalogue, slash commands, i18n) can revert to near-upstream and auto-merge if the fork consumes upstream_list.concat(FORK_ROWS) with FORK_ROWS in a fork-only module. Converts ACCEPT->clean-merge and inherits upstream's new rows for free.

specialCaseRulings.new_index_tsx: OVERLAY recommended (not pure REVERT): 1917 delta, fork 583 vs upstream 1851; leaf UI screen but carries E2 remote-daemon pickers. Relocate fork screen to sources/fork/newSession/ + route flag; upstream screen merges near-clean. Operator-call REVERT-vs-OVERLAY.
specialCaseRulings.voice_realtime: KEEP-DELETED (E5). Minimal-conflict reframe does NOT override: restoring re-adds central-server credential broker (E2), continuous mic->cloud egress, animated VoiceAssistantStatusBar (E4), + 2 npm deps. Maintaining the deletion is cheap/guard-tested; owning the restored subsystem is not. Mic UI already inert (HA-6). Restore only on explicit operator request, bypass-only e-ink-static default-off variant.
specialCaseRulings.removed_planes: ESSENTIAL keep-deleted (HA-49..52 + voice). Confirmed absent at HEAD. Every REVERT wave gates on encryptionDeletion.spec.ts + per-file Test-Path==false so no revert resurrects them.
